children: Malaysia's leading economic index rose 0.3% month-on-month in July 2026, unchanged from June's upwardly revised figure.

The increase in the leading economic index was boosted by a further rise in real imports of other basic precious and non-ferrous metals (0.1% vs 0.9% in June), the number of housing units approved (0.04% vs 0.5%), real imports of semiconductors (0.1% vs 0.2%), a rebound in real money supply M1 (0.1% vs -0.1%), and expected sales value in manufacturing (0.1% vs -0.4%).
On an annual basis, the leading index increased 1.1%, easing from an upwardly revised 1.5% in June.
Meanwhile, the coincident index, a gauge of current economic conditions, edged down 0.1% month-on-month, reversing a 0.3% gain in June.

title: Malaysia Leading Index Steady at 0.3% in July
